description: v4 (2026-09-22): a pass that refuses to start now says why in a receipt. Every abort BEFORE the project loop (a stale or unreadable mail attribution index, a root table that no longer hashes to its pin, any other preflight refusal) used to print one stderr line and exit 2, writing nothing -- and the night chain, like every watcher here, reads receipts, so a scheduled run's reason was lost with its console. estate_graph_sync.mjs now writes one <receipts>/_preflight/<instant>.json (soulforge.context_graph_sync_preflight_receipt.v1: status FAILED, stage, reason, projects []) on those paths. A per-project receipt's shape and content are untouched, the exit code is still 2, --dry still writes nothing, and a receipts directory that cannot be written costs the receipt but never the exit code. New id rather than an in-place rebuild, per the same rule v3 followed. v3 (2026-09-22): carries the mail attribution reader (harness/mail_routes.mjs) and the estate_inventory mail branch that reads it, so a mail's project is decided by the workspace ledgers' published attribution index rather than by the project code standing alone in the mail text. The index is a data input read by alias address (--mail-attribution, default control_root/mail-routes/mail_attribution_index.json), produced OUTSIDE this lane by guild_hall/workspace_ledgers/ops/mail_attribution_index.mjs, so this lane gains no new module dependency and the classifier stays in one place. Without the flag the lane behaves exactly as v2 did. v2 (2026-09-15) carried the voice route ledger and conversation-segment grant items (estate_inventory voice branch, voice_session_source segment_ids scope) so a person-confirmed conversation segment reaches a project's graph. The lane SoulforgeGraphSync executes every 30 minutes: guild_hall/context_engine/harness/estate_graph_sync.mjs, which re-lists what custody holds for each named project, updates that project's graph index generation, and loads it into the unified graph database (sfgraph-unified, bolt 7690). tracked_paths are the context engine itself plus exactly the dependency files its own runtime closure records (guild_hall/context_engine/release/runtime-closure.json, 30 files across engineering_engine, gateway, knowledge_access, path_registry, rag and shared) plus path_registry/src/root_table.mjs, which the harness reads directly. There are no carried_forward_prefixes: every module in the closure imports node: builtins only, so this lane needs no node_modules and can be built without a previous lane.
